label: DS-29 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the single-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 29 locus cataloged as working transcriptional unit HEP3 and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the HEP3 source working identifier, the individual DS-29 protein, the DS-29 HMM profile row, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, the HEPN-like HHpred-domain annotation, the absent DS-29 rule-level DefenseFinder model, unresolved DS-29 component activity and phage readouts, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
